question: The Indian Men's Cricket Team played their thousandth ODI match against which team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Indies**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Men's Cricket Team played their thousandth ODI match against **West Indies**.
 
• This milestone match was a significant event in the history of Indian cricket.
 
• The Indian cricket team is one of the most successful teams in the world and has a rich history in ODI cricket.
 
• Playing a thousand ODI matches is a testament to the team's longevity and success in the international arena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ODI (One Day International) cricket** is a format of limited overs cricket, played between two international teams, with each team facing a fixed number of overs, usually 50.
 
• The first ODI was played on 5 January 1971 between Australia and England at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
 
• The Indian cricket team played its first ODI match on 13 July 1974 against England at the Headingley Stadium in Leeds.
 
• India has won two ICC Cricket World Cups in 1983 and 2011.
 
• Over the years, several Indian cricketers have achieved significant milestones in ODI cricket, contributing to the team's success.
